“With FDA clearance of our IND, encouraging Phase 1 results and a strong financial position, we expect to commence the Phase 2 ASCENTRA-UC trial in the second half of 2026.

We believe that PALI-2108’s targeted activation and localized delivery in both the ileum and colon are particularly relevant to Crohn’s disease, which can affect multiple regions of the gastrointestinal tract.
We are finalizing the design of the Phase 2 ASCENTRA-CD trial and expect to submit an IND in the second half of 2026.

The Company believes PALI-2108 has the potential to address these limitations through once-daily oral dosing, targeted lower-intestinal bioactivation and broad PDE4-mediated anti-inflammatory activity.
